scope: Focused corroboration only, not a claim to have watched all externally sourced video footage.

observations.finding: Small red-clad rifle infantry oppose blue troops with muzzle flashes and combat bars. Hostile role is visibly supported.
observations.mapping: Requires a distinct appearance row; current rival rifleman candidate addresses it pending pouch repair.

observations.finding: A substantially larger red-coated white-bearded armed figure fights among smaller red infantry. Distinct silhouette/scale/face warrants a separate visual variant.
observations.uncertainty: Exact source-defined rank or tier name is not proven.

observations.finding: Low-resolution previews show a title resembling Startled Giant Elk and a bulky brown/gold antlered combat target.
observations.limitation: Two preview composites inspected; not full YT01 playback or every storyboard.

observations.finding: A bulky white-furred gray-faced target has red horns and combat context. It is visually distinct from the existing blue-ice-plated Ice Brute.
observations.limitation: Low-resolution preview cannot prove exact species, rank or a complete reverse design.

observations.finding: Pale gray/white lean long-legged antlered animals have dark branching antlers and red health bars at roughly 16–24 seconds; materially distinct from bulky brown/gold YT01 elk.
observations.role: Huntable/combat wildlife. Camp-invader role not established.
observations.mapping: Separate appearance row and render pair warranted.
observations.limitation: Actual storyboard previews inspected; exact species and full-motion behavior are not established.

non_enemy_exclusion: Small blue frozen/crouched humanoid forms in YT01 previews are not sufficient evidence for a snowman enemy. Primary B red axe workers remain hired helpers based on the purchase/harvesting sequence.
